classes.A_HISTORICAL_BACKFILL_NOW: free, history exists, host already reachable: pull and build (no vintage problem)
classes.B_PROSPECTIVE_CAPTURE_START_NOW: no usable history: start recording from a host that is already reachable today; every day of delay is history that is lost
classes.C_NEEDS_HOST_DECISION: free and historical but the host is blocked from the runner (see NETWORK_ACCESS_PROPOSAL.md)
classes.C_PROSPECTIVE_NEEDS_PERMITTED_HOST: vintage data whose only free feed is on a host not currently reachable or restricted
classes.D_BLOCKED_OR_SAMPLE_ONLY: paid, none found, or only a free sample
